verdict.rationale: Galileo documents experiments that evaluate prompts, models and application code against chosen metrics, plus a Python SDK. Nothing in the evidence pack shows a CI integration, a CI workflow, or a pass/fail threshold that gates deployments. Those experiment and SDK features are building blocks, and the threshold alerts in evidence apply to production logs, so they are an adjacent feature rather than deployment gating.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results
